name: Tadasana
description: A foundational standing pose that improves posture and body awareness.

slouching.english: Stand tall, roll your shoulders back.
slouching.marathi: सरळ उभे राहा, तुमचे खांदे मागे घ्या.

name: Adho Mukha Svanasana
description: An inversion that stretches the entire back body and builds upper body strength.

shoulders_forward.english: Push your hips back and up.
shoulders_forward.marathi: तुमचे नितंब मागे आणि वर ढकला.

knees_bent.english: Gently straighten your legs if comfortable.
knees_bent.marathi: जर शक्य असेल तर पाय हळूवारपणे सरळ करा.

name: Vrikshasana
description: A balancing pose that improves focus and strengthens the legs and core.

foot_on_knee.english: Place your foot above or below the knee, not on the joint.
foot_on_knee.marathi: तुमचा पाय गुडघ्याच्या वर किंवा खाली ठेवा, सांध्यावर नाही.

wobbling.english: Find a focal point in front of you.
wobbling.marathi: समोरच्या एका बिंदूवर लक्ष केंद्रित करा.

name: Virabhadrasana I
description: A deep lunge that stretches the hip flexors and strengthens the legs and back.

front_knee_past_ankle.english: Ensure your front knee is directly over your ankle.
front_knee_past_ankle.marathi: तुमचा पुढचा गुडघा घोट्याच्या सरळ रेषेत असावा.

arms_bent.english: Reach your arms straight up towards the ceiling.
arms_bent.marathi: तुमचे हात छताकडे सरळ वर करा.

name: Virabhadrasana II
description: A standing pose that builds stamina and stretches the hips and groin.

knee_collapsing_in.english: Keep your front knee pointing straight ahead.
knee_collapsing_in.marathi: तुमचा पुढचा गुडघा सरळ पुढे ठेवा.

arms_uneven.english: Keep both arms parallel to the floor.

name: Trikonasana
description: A standing side stretch that opens the chest and stretches the hamstrings.

chest_facing_floor.english: Open your chest towards the side.

front_knee_bent.english: Try to keep both legs straight, but don't lock your knees.
front_knee_bent.marathi: दोन्ही पाय सरळ ठेवण्याचा प्रयत्न करा, पण गुडघे कडक करू नका.

name: Bhujangasana
description: A gentle backbend that strengthens the spine and opens the chest.

shoulders_by_ears.english: Relax your shoulders away from your ears.
shoulders_by_ears.marathi: तुमचे खांदे कानांपासून दूर आणि सैल ठेवा.

arms_fully_straight.english: Keep a slight bend in your elbows.

name: Balasana
description: A resting pose that gently stretches the hips, thighs, and ankles.

hips_high.english: Sink your hips back towards your heels.

name: Paschimottanasana
description: A calming forward bend that stretches the hamstrings and lower back.

rounding_back.english: Keep your back straight and fold from the hips.
rounding_back.marathi: तुमची पाठ सरळ ठेवा आणि नितंबातून पुढे वाका.

name: Uttanasana
description: An intense forward stretch that calms the brain and stretches the hamstrings.

locked_knees.english: Keep a micro-bend in your knees.
